close_reason: Added unknown_capability_with_detail() to jmap-types; check_known_capabilities now uses it; test verifies description contains URI
description: RFC 8620 §3.6.1.1 example shows 'detail' naming the unrecognised URI. JmapError::unknown_capability() sets description:None so the HTTP problem-details response has no detail field. Caller has no way to include the bad URI because check_known_capabilities() returns Err without recording which URI failed. A client that receives unknownCapability cannot tell which of several declared URIs was rejected.
title: unknownCapability error omits the unrecognised URI from detail
